title: Full-gate container-start burst and expiry lock-wait oracle
source: Nous change ledger CHG-067 (partition child of CHG-066)

outcomes.statement: The full gate (pnpm check, turbo forced, default package and file parallelism) passes ten of ten runs on an unchanged tree started from zero stale test containers: the expiry lock-wait oracle asserts only once the updater backend waits on the lock, and fixture container starts no longer exceed testcontainers 12.0.4 hardcoded 10 s port-binding wait under a start burst.
outcomes.demo: Ten consecutive TURBO_FORCE=true pnpm check runs on one committed candidate from zero stale containers, docker ps -q | wc -l recorded before each run and sampled every 5 s; all ten exit 0, wall time recorded per run.

uncertainties.statement: Shape of the container-start burst fix.
uncertainties.resolution: testcontainers 12.0.4 inspectContainerUntilPortsExposed has a hardcoded 10 s default with no option, and CHG-066 observed it exceeded when up to 13 fixture containers start together. The fix in packages/db/src/testing/postgres-container.ts holds a cross-process file lock only around each container start, released once its ports are bound and before role bootstrap and tests; tests stay file- and package-parallel, so this is not serial scheduling. A RED test starts N fixture containers concurrently and records the start overlap under the lock (never assumed). If the lock does not remove the timeout in the round, stop and return; one container per vitest worker is the larger alternative and needs re-approval.

uncertainties.statement: Root cause of the expiry lock-wait oracle failure.
uncertainties.resolution: apps/worker automatic-invitation-expiry.integration.test.ts waits for the updater pid to be state=active and then asserts pg_blocking_pids non-empty; a backend is active from query start, before it reaches the row lock, so under load the assertion can run before the wait. The oracle waits for wait_event_type=Lock on that pid instead (the condition the assertion means), keeping the existing 10 s deadline; RED by asserting immediately after the active state under an injected delay.
Both changed sources are excluded by scripts/mutation-scope.mjs (testing/ and *.test.ts): zero shards, no previews, no cold campaign, no test_report.
